title: What does it cost two laundry-hanging arms to empty the same dryer pile?
summary: Two arms emptying one hanger-pick pile, each waiting if its grasp is closer than a clearance to the other's, in the hanger-cell model: at 0.30 m aiming falls from 201 to 191 garments hung or folded per hour (5.7 dryers) and blind pinching from 179 to 151, since pinching keeps arms busier and they meet more (18 blocked picks per load against 10). A third arm adds only 3 to 5 per hour. Stylised: the clearance, the spacing time and all station times are assumed.
lede: what does it cost two laundry-hanging arms to empty one dryer pile and wait for each other? Blocking at 0.30 m clearance takes aiming from 201 to 191 garments an hour and blind pinching from 179 to 151; a third arm adds only 3 to 5. Stylised: clearance and spacing assumed.
